Re-running prep appends newly added fragments to the existing [V]; with none pending the file is unchanged byte for byte (test)

Legacy release-cut --require-prepared refuses when [V] is missing or fragments are pending (test); check_release_curation accounts for changelog.d

description:
OBJECTIVE: Release preparation builds the dated '## [X.Y.Z]' CHANGELOG.md section from changelog.d fragments (library from changelog-fragments-01), instead of from commit subjects, and fails closed when fragments are pending at tag time. [Unreleased] stays empty. This item changes the release path and is a soundness path; it must not change the already-curated [0.5.0rc1] section.

CHANGE (re-verify every location against the live tree first; lines drift):
 1. scripts/generate_changelog_entry.py: add --compile-fragments --version V. Steps: (a) validate all fragments, stop BEFORE writing anything if any is invalid; (b) starting draft = existing [V] body if re-run, else body of the newest pre-release section of the same base version (e.g. [0.5.0rc1] when V is 0.5.0 or 0.5.0rc2), else empty; (c) append user entries under the five canonical headings in fixed order, appending into existing headings, creating missing ones in order, never duplicating a heading; (d) write '## [V] - DATE' directly below an empty [Unreleased], removing pre-release sections that were folded in; (e) update compare links: pre-release V adds [V]: .../compare/v<prev-final>...vV and leaves [Unreleased] at the previous final; final V folds all pre-release sections, drops their links, adds the [V] link and sets [Unreleased]: .../compare/vV...HEAD (what find_release_accounting_errors expects once V is published; previous final tag from latest_release_tag(before_version=V)); (f) delete every consumed fragment (user and internal) - git history is the archive, no archive dir; (g) print the worksheet (file -> PR -> category -> tags), bullet/line counts against 45/160, and a coverage report listing feat/fix/perf squash commits since the previous final tag that added no fragment. Re-running prep with [V] present appends new fragments; with none pending it is a no-op.
 2. check_changelog_curation: reject duplicate '###' headings (verify all shipped sections still pass tests/unit/scripts/test_generate_changelog_entry.py every-shipped-section test). Do NOT add an allowed-heading list (0.4.0 used Removed/New/Security).
 3. Remove commit-subject drafting (_build_raw_changelog), the Claude summarizer and BENCHBOX_CHANGELOG_SUMMARIZE, RAW_PLACEHOLDER and its rule, the --since-ref patch-delta logic and --since-tag; KEEP _commits_since_ref for the coverage report. Check Makefile release-cut and every caller before deleting.
 4. scripts/release_flow.py: prep invokes --compile-fragments (replacing the changelog draft step); add 'check --pre-tag' (Make var RELEASE_PRE_TAG=1) that fails if any changelog.d/*.json exists; select reports release-identity-changed separately from enforcement-file changes (needed by item 03's CI check); add scripts/changelog_fragments.py to the enforcement-file list.
 5. Use --pre-tag in .github/workflows/release-v2.yml at tag-time release-check, and in ci.yml's release check only when select reports release identity changed.
 6. Legacy release-cut recipe in Makefile: replace the draft step with --require-prepared ([V] must exist and no fragments pending); keep the CHANGELOG_SECTION override and --check-curation; add changelog.d to the 'git rm' list so scripts/check_release_curation.py accounts for the new top-level dir.
 7. .github/soundness-paths.txt row for new/changed release files; docs/internal/release-guide.md (changelog sections) rewritten for the fragment flow; tests rewritten (generator, release_flow, release_infrastructure).

FRAGMENT SCHEMA and rules: defined in item changelog-fragments-01-library (show_item). Do not redefine.

DECISION GATES:
  G0 changelog-fragments-01 is done (merged) and its library is on develop.
  G1 Release-safety gate, checked live at PR-open AND immediately before arming: no open release-prep PR (gh pr list for release-prep/prepare release), no in-progress release-v2.yml run (gh run list --workflow release-v2.yml), and dlv2-52a/dlv2-52 are not mid-publish. If a prep PR or publish run is active, STOP and record waiting; do not merge.
  G2 Backward check: make release-check VERSION=<current pyproject version> passes unchanged on the PR head and the [0.5.0rc1] section is byte-identical to develop's (diff the section).
  G3 Soundness review: oracle review (very-high tier expected); resolve every thread; arm only on a success review of the current head.

GUARDRAILS: linked worktree only; AGENTS.md rules (uv run --, no explanatory comments, comment-policy-check, stage explicit paths, no attribution trailers, durable commit/PR text); never rebuild or alter release artifacts; no tags/rulesets/branches/labels/environments; do not edit CHANGELOG.md content except what tests require via fixtures (not the real file); do not delete test coverage that guards behavior still present - delete only tests that pinned removed code (summarizer, since-ref drafting); no skipped/quarantined tests; run make pr-preflight once then make pr-open; monitor to merge.
